answer: A vault releases work only after bonding umber to one meadow, a metered ground plot whose attestation cannot be cloned; shared funding, rack or route folds heads into that meadow. First head locks 10 umber. A principal with r live heads adds 10(r+1) umber plus r+1 unrelated meadow attestations; overlap burns the vault. n fakes: 5n(n+1) umber and n(n+1)/2 plots.
